text: The purpose of this report is to provide a summary of the 2020 Toronto Heritage Grant Program. The Toronto Heritage Grant Selection Committee recommended seventeen grants in 2020 totalling $317,000.00 under the Toronto Heritage Grant Program. The recommended recipients will generate approximately $931,371.00 in private investment for work to conserve irreplaceable cultural heritage resources that contribute to the City's social and economic prosperity by defining our unique sense of place. At its meeting of June 15, 2020, the Planning and Housing Committee recommended that City Council approve the seventeen grant awards for the 2020 Toronto Heritage Grant Program.
